continuity.campaign_development: April 59 BCE: Following the destruction of the organized bandit holdouts, Valerius consolidated the occupied estate belt, reopened civilian roads, processed recovered records, and maintained correspondence with Marcus Claudius Marcellus. A newly surfaced local property claim remained unresolved. On 27 April, a sealed dispatch from Quintus Caecilius Metellus Celer widened the political attention surrounding the recovered register and requested preservation of the source material. The expedition remains at 398 soldiers; supply is 58, exhaustion 69, readiness 97, intelligence 1027, and relations 108. Personal holdings remain 4.25 sq mi; the disputed tract was not acquired.
continuity.land_area_history: Round 33 establishes 4.00 square miles as the measured pre-existing footprint: 3.00 sq mi principal estate + 1.00 sq mi lake-port holding, reconstructed from established holding descriptors. Round 42 adds a confirmed 0.25 sq mi of new estate acquisitions. Current total remains 4.25 sq mi.

event_variety_policy.rule: Do not make every event about the same subject. Prefer distinct news dimensions supported by current state: military operations, intelligence, logistics, political relationships, economic/property activity, social/local developments, personal developments, geography, and reactions. Variety must arise from simulation context and must not be fabricated solely to fill slots.
